name: Space Coast Credit Union
notes: Researched from the public sccu.com Help Center FAQ. The live site answers scripted requests with a ShieldSquare bot challenge (not bypassed); the FAQ text was read from the Internet Archive copy dated 2026-10-03; the reviewer re-read the live FAQ on 2026-10-10 (it loaded without a challenge). Loans are paid in Online Banking or the SCCU Mobile app: transfers from SCCU accounts (Immediate, Future or Recurring), or External Loan Payments under the Transfers tab from another institution; payoffs cannot be made from an external account. Accepted: checking/savings or debit card, no credit cards (card-type restriction not expressible: card is listed as an online method). Recurring payments may use checking, savings or debit card. If a late fee has been assessed on a mortgage payment (FAQ: why can't I make my mortgage payment online), online payment is disabled until a team member processes the payment and late fee (rule shown as the pay_online note; cannot be enforced by the engine). Phone: Call-24 at (800) 447-7228 (member and loan numbers). Mail: P.O. Box 419001, Melbourne, FL 32941-9001. Online Banking shows 6 years of statements (Statements & Notices / View Statements and Notices). Enrollment needs phone number and last 4 of SSN, then a verification text and username/password. No pay-without-logging-in page is mentioned (guest_pay unsupported, inferred). Hardship: Credit Solutions team (phone).

pay_online.note: Pay from a checking or savings account or a debit card; credit cards are not accepted. If a mortgage payment has been charged a late fee, online payment for that loan is turned off until an SCCU team member processes the payment and late fee.

guest_pay.note: SCCU loans are paid in Online Banking or the SCCU Mobile app. Without them, use Call-24 phone banking at (800) 447-7228, visit a branch, or mail your payment.

autopay.note: Recurring payments can come from a checking or savings account or a debit card, from SCCU or another bank.

payment_arrangement.note: SCCU has no online payment plan. If you are facing financial hardship, call (800) 447-7228 to reach the Credit Solutions team.

pay_by_phone.note: Call (800) 447-7228 and follow the prompts; have your member and loan numbers ready.

help.title: What are my payment options?
paragraphs: Pay online: enroll in Online Banking with your loan information and member number, or use the SCCU Mobile app. Use a transfer from your SCCU account, or External Loan Payments under the Transfers tab to pay with money from another institution. Loan payoffs cannot be made from an external account.

Pay by phone at (800) 447-7228 and follow the prompts with your member and loan numbers, pay at any SCCU branch, or mail your payment with your loan number to Space Coast Credit Union, P.O. Box 419001, Melbourne, FL 32941-9001.

You can pay with a checking or savings account or a debit card, but not with a credit card. Extra money above your payment goes to principal, and a principal-only payment can be chosen in the Payment Options list.

help.title: Set up an automatic recurring loan payment
paragraphs: Set up a recurring payment in Online Banking or the Mobile Banking app. In Transfers choose the from and to accounts, enter the amount and pick Recurring, then select the frequency, start date and duration.
Recurring payments can come from a checking or savings account or a debit card, at SCCU or another financial institution.

help.title: View statements in Online Banking
paragraphs: Online Banking keeps your last 6 years of statements. Select View Statements and Notices under Quick Links, then open the PDF to view, print or download. For older copies (up to 5 years) contact the Member Service Center.

help.title: Mortgage payments after a late fee
paragraphs: If a late fee has been charged on your mortgage payment, you can no longer pay that mortgage online. An SCCU team member has to process your scheduled payment and the late fee before online payment is available again, so call the Member Service Center at (800) 447-7228 or visit a branch.

help.title: Payment history and past statements
paragraphs: Online Banking keeps your last 6 years of statements. Select View Statements and Notices under Quick Links to view, print or download one.
Payments you make online appear in your payment history; a pending payment shows until it posts.
steps: Open your payment history or statements.
Select a statement to view or download.
